summary: Tested the new seeker eligibility gating + referral/₹100 registration, company ₹49 CV unlock, storage limits and multi-file upload, plus regression (chat role blink, CV parse -> Standard CV, admin Feedback console, boost ₹100). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_eligibility.py (19 cases) covering GET /eligibility, POST /referral/share (group/contact counters), /referral/claim (400 until 2 groups OR 10 contacts, 200 after), /register/pay (amount 100, reg_paid), /matches seeker gating (company_name '🔒 Locked' + empty mobile/email before eligible, real values after), provider locked candidates, /unlock-cv (amount 49, reveals name/mobile/email, persists, 404 on unknown id), /documents/usage user_type crew(100MB)/company(5MB), per-file >5MB -> 400, company total 5MB -> 400. Full suite 49/49 pytest passed (fixed one stale assertion in backend_test.py that still expected unlock amount 20). Frontend E2E (all with freshly seeded accounts so the documented demo accounts keep their state): seeker gate renders with RECOMMENDED free referral + computed line-through on ₹100, vacancy cards show '🔒 Locked' + 'Company name & contact locked' and no WhatsApp button; claim button disabled at 0/2; two 'Share to group' clicks open api.whatsapp.com popups and progress reaches 2/2; 'Claim free access' -> gate disappears, eligible-banner shows, real company names + 'Contact <company> on WhatsApp' deep links (phone prefilled). Paid path: 'Pay ₹100 & register' -> immediately eligible + contacts revealed. Company: 13 candidate cards, blurred contact block with note 'Name, contact, INDOS, CDC, passport & photo hidden', button 'Unlock full CV · ₹49' -> reveals Rajesh Nair/+919812345670/email, 'Unlocked' badge + green WhatsApp deep link. Documents: input has multiple attr, 3 files uploaded at once -> '3 documents uploaded' toast and all listed; >5MB file rejected (400) and not listed. Regression: role boxes animate (role-blink / role-blink-blue), CV parse produced Standard CV with DD MM YYYY dates and red missing badge, admin +910000000000 -> /admin Feedback console lists 7 items, boost ₹100 works and appears in History. Mobile 390px: gate lays out with no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: No validation of `type`: any value other than 'group' (e.g. 'foo') silently increments contact_shares. Should reject with 422/400 for unknown types.
Idempotency not guarded — repeated /register/pay inserts a duplicate ₹100 payment record each call (History will show multiple ₹100 registrations).

ui_bugs.issue: STALE PRICING copy: 'Companies unlock full CVs for just ₹20. Boost yours for ₹100.' — unlock price is now ₹49, and the landing page never mentions the seeker referral/₹100 registration.
History row label hardcodes the old price: 'CV Unlocked (₹20)' instead of ₹49.

A >5MB file is rejected by the backend (400 'Each file must be 5 MB or smaller') but the UI shows the wrong reason: '1 file skipped — exceeds your 100 MB limit'. Per-file cap should be checked client-side / the backend detail surfaced.
The lock overlay text 'Name, contact, INDOS, CDC, passport & photo hidden' is rendered on top of the blurred Name/Mobile/Email rows, so the two overlap and the note is hard to read on smaller cards.

issues: Vacancy cards whose provider has no summary keep an empty 48px block (e.g. 'Priority Test Co' card) leaving a visible gap
Navbar brand wraps to 3 lines ('SMART / CREWING / CREW · MATCH · SAIL') and overlaps the top edge
Share to group / Send to contact buttons are 32px tall — below the 44px touch-target guideline

critical_code_review_comments: Documents.jsx handleFiles closes over `limitMB` which is declared later in the component body — it works only because the handler runs post-render; move the const above the handler to avoid a future TDZ crash.

Referral eligibility is entirely self-reported (click count + Claim); a user can call POST /api/referral/share twice via the API and claim. Acceptable for the mocked demo but should be flagged as non-verifiable.
server.py is 1158 lines — consider splitting (auth / matching+eligibility / documents / cv / admin) per the 700-line guideline.
